f1_previous_method_defect.previous: derive name-version from .dist-info directory names with sed -E 's/-py3.*//; s/\.dist-info//'
f1_previous_method_defect.finding: the regex only strips a tag literally beginning -py3; it yields correct output in this uv-created environment where all 117 directories are name-version.dist-info, but is environment-dependent and not robust

f1_limitations: a distribution inventory is NOT a lockfile: it does not pin hashes and says nothing about artifact integrity
it is NOT a dependency-graph proof: it records what is installed, not what was resolved from requirements.txt, and cannot show whether the installed set satisfies the declared requirements
it records installed state only; it cannot distinguish a direct from a transitive dependency, nor detect an extra undeclared package

METADATA yields canonical distribution names (Jinja2, PyYAML) while a filename method yields filesystem-normalized names (jinja2, pyyaml); only the former is authoritative, which matters when comparing against requirements.txt
the repository still has no lockfile of any kind; F1 mitigates this for measurement purposes but does not close the gap
